seo.title: Brand Kit
seo.description: AFAQ Scientific Club visual identity: logo, colour palette, typography and downloadable brand assets.

hero.title: AFAQ Brand Kit
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to design for AFAQ — the mark, the colours, the type. Click anything to copy it, or grab the whole kit in one file.
hero.zipNote: Logos (SVG + PNG), fonts (WOFF2 + TTF) and palette files

logo.title: The mark
logo.subtitle: A lightning bolt breaking through a circle: energy, electronics and the horizon (آفاق) the club opens. Use the SVG whenever you can.
logo.customHint: Pick any colour and size, then download a PNG on a transparent or solid background.

rules.title: Logo rules
rules.clearspace: Keep clear space equal to the bolt's width on every side.
rules.minSize: Minimum size: 24 px on screen, 10 mm in print.
rules.contrast: Only place the mark on backgrounds from the palette with strong contrast.
rules.dont1: Don't stretch, rotate or skew the mark.
rules.dont2: Don't add shadows, outlines or gradients.
rules.dont3: Don't recolour it outside the brand palette.

colors.title: Colour palette
colors.subtitle: Seven colours, from deep night to open sky. Click a swatch to copy its HEX, or copy any format below it.
colors.tintsHint: Click any step to copy it.
colors.pairingsHint: WCAG contrast ratio of text on background. AA needs 4.5 for body text, 3 for large titles.

type.title: Typography
type.subtitle: Pixel fonts for titles and graphic elements, Thmanyah for Arabic and running text. Every file is downloadable.
type.scaleHint: Latin and Arabic side by side. Click a row to copy its CSS.
type.license: Thmanyah by thmanyah (free to use) · Unixel under SIL OFL 1.1 · Minecraft font by Craftron Gaming (check licence before commercial use).

bg.title: Background generator
bg.subtitle: Make on-brand wallpapers, social covers and slide backgrounds. Pick a theme and a pattern, tweak it, then download a full-resolution PNG.
bg.copyFailed: Image copy not supported in this browser

items.d: Latin titles in Minecraft, Arabic titles in Unixel. Keep them short and large.
Thmanyah Sans Regular for both Arabic and Latin paragraphs. Medium for emphasis.
Thmanyah Serif Display for Arabic quotes, posters and long-form headings.
Roughly 60% Midnight or Cloud, 30% Deep Blue / Slate, 10% Afaq Blue or Sky as accent.
